comment: I think the questions could be designed based on some kind of user profiling. Someone traveling on business could find the detailed questions about the TV more useful and the kettle, maybe not so much. A couple might find the bathtub questions more relevant. Co-relating the AI questions based on the user and the booking type could deem to be useful.
It's quite difficult to determine the quality of these questions as some things are already evident from the photos.
Never really given any attention to these things in detail, but if the AI generated questions are provided, depending on the type of trip, it can help solve a lot of problems in general.
